deviation_types.description: A protocol-defined reject message was observed (Registration reject, Authentication reject, Security mode reject, Service reject)
A protocol unsuccessful outcome was observed (InitialContextSetupFailure; Authentication failure)
An entered procedure branch's expected counterpart was not observed within the observation window
A lower layer reported an UNKNOWN or UNSUPPORTED message or value
A lower layer reported a conflicting identifier binding or correlation uncertainty
A security-protected NAS envelope carried no decodable inner message
The observation window begins mid-procedure or ends before expected evidence could appear
Input records arrived in non-chronological order; ordering was normalized
Repeated identical signaling observations were preserved as duplicate or retransmission evidence

boundary: Every deviation is procedure-local. A deviation is not end-to-end root cause; implementation blame is never derivable from these observations.
